special_events.name: Matariki and Hindu Traditions
special_events.tagline: ✨ Matariki & Hindu Traditions Webinar ✨ Join us for an exploration of the connections between Matariki and Hindu traditions, as we reflect on the significance of celestial beings and their influence on collective culture. Are there parallels between the Nine Stars of Matariki and the Saptrishi (Ursa Major) constilation of the Hindu tradition? What can these ancient wisdom traditions teach us about community, remembrance, renewal, and our relationship with the cosmos? Come together in the spirit of learning, celebration, and cultural understanding as we explore these shared themes and perspectives.
